rationale: Builds on the 0031 reverse recurrent-tail baseline with a compact structural change: each repeated tail block now stores its original decoder activation and learns a per-block blend between that local anchor and the final decoder anchor before the carry gate fires. This tests a new recurrence-allocation idea, not another scalar sweep, while staying compile-stable, byte-light, and under the 1500-line cap.
title: Reverse Tail Local-Global Anchor Blend
